extraction.notes: All three subtotals tie: FFO 2,922+153+122+22,514 = 25,711; Core FFO 25,711 - 7,096 = 18,615; Core AFFO 18,615 + 3,019 = 21,634. Amounts are the three-months-ended June 30, 2024 column. The '—' entries are recorded as 0. Category judgments: 'Amortization of derivative premium' was mapped to debt_cost_amortization (no better fit; it is a premium amortization, not a fair-value change). Market lease intangibles amortization and lease inducements were mapped to straight_line_rent as similar non-cash revenue adjustments. The 'Redemption value adjustments' line is zero this quarter and was mapped to 'other'. The diluted share count is NOT printed on these pages; the 102,844 value is implied from FFO of 25,711 divided by reported FFO per share of $0.25, so it is approximate (rounding of $0.25 allows roughly 100.8k to 104.9k). Footnote 6 gives OP units of 8,689 for the quarter, but the total weighted average common shares plus units figure is not on these pages. Company AFFO deducts building improvements (recurring capex) and TI/LC, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Reconciliation is on page 9 (seq 12) and the same tables repeat on seq 38; page 10 (seq 13) holds Adjusted EBITDA, which was not used.
